caption: A sheet of glass is held at an angle to a window, and the garden outside appears faintly in the glass over the room behind it.

sa.check: A sheet of glass is held at an angle to a window.
The garden outside appears faintly in the glass over the room behind it.
The reflected garden shifts as the glass tilts.
The reflected garden is dim and mirrored.

pc.expect: The reflected garden shifts as the glass tilts and would disappear if the glass were laid flat away from the window.
pc.fail: It stays fixed as the glass tilts; or it is there with the glass facing away from the window; or it is missing with the glass angled to the window.

pc.expect: The reflected garden is dim and mirrored, seen over the room behind the glass.
pc.fail: It is brighter than the room; or not mirrored; or the room behind is hidden.

pc.expect: The reflection changes only as the glass moves.
pc.fail: It shifts with the glass still; or moves before the tilt.

pc.expect: The glass is flat and rigid: the reflection is undistorted.
pc.fail: It ripples; or warps; or bends.

pc.expect: One sheet of glass and one window.
pc.fail: The glass duplicates; or the hand passes through it; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: The garden, the room and the window stay the same.
pc.fail: The garden changes; or the room rearranges; or the window changes.

note: The hands holding the glass are the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
